hero.title: Meet Skipper
hero.lede: Boomertanger's furry co-host and the most requested face on stream. She keeps chat company between the screams, and she's already waiting to say hi.
hero.caption: Captain of the float

meet: Skipper is a fan favorite, and she knows it. When the game gets scary, she's the comfort break chat didn't know it needed.
She snoozes through jump scares, pops in for treat breaks and brings heart, humor and a lot of wholesome chaos to every broadcast.

Off stream she keeps busy. She herds balls around the backyard, catches frisbees, goes on neighborhood walks, cools off in the pool on warm days and keeps the rabbits on their toes. She loves people, and she never says no to a tummy rub.

favorites.title: Herding balls
favorites.text: A herding dog with no cattle, so the backyard balls get rounded up instead. Even the big one.

favorites.title: Frisbee catches
favorites.text: She'll catch a frisbee anywhere. Even from her pool float.

favorites.title: Neighborhood walks
favorites.text: Every patch of grass gets a full inspection. Nobody rushes Skipper on a walk.

favorites.title: Daytime naps
favorites.text: Belly up, eyes shut, completely off duty. Afternoons are for napping.

favorites.title: Pool days
favorites.text: On a warm day you'll find her floating, cool as can be.

favorites.title: Playing ball
favorites.text: Toss it up and she goes straight up after it. Poolside is her favorite court.

cam.lede: A live look at Skipper whenever Boomer's in the office. Fan Club only.
cam.liveText: She's on right now. You might catch a nap, a toy, or a very serious stare at the door.
cam.offText: She's live whenever Boomer's working in the office. Check back soon, or come say hi on stream.
rules: It switches itself off if Boomer forgets.

lock.title: The Skipper Cam is for the Fan Club
lock.text: Joining is free. Sign in to watch her live whenever Boomer's in the office.

corgis.lede: Short legs, big ears and a royal fan club. Everything you wanted to know about Skipper's breed.
corgis.split: They were shown as one breed until The Kennel Club in the UK split them in 1934.
pembroke: Red, sable, fawn, black and tan, usually with white
cardigan: A wider range, including blue merle (shown) and brindle
numbers: In Stanley Coren's dog intelligence ranking
corgis.royal: Queen Elizabeth II loved corgis her whole life and owned more than 30 of them during her reign. They became part of the royal image around the world.
timeline: Her father brings home Dookie, the family's first corgi
Susan arrives for her 18th birthday and starts a line of about 14 generations
Corgi and dachshund crosses, after a royal dachshund named Pipkin
Her corgis appear with “James Bond” in the London Olympics opening film
Willow, the last of Susan's line, dies
Her last two corgis, Muick and Sandy, find a new home with family
quirks: Flat out with both back legs stretched behind. Corgis are famous for it.
Short legs, loud voice. Herding dogs were bred to be heard.
Some corgis herd kids, cats and other dogs. Skipper herds balls.
That thick double coat sheds a lot, especially twice a year.
Corgis are famously food-motivated. Treat breaks are serious business.
Those short legs come from a form of dwarfism built into the breed.

reel.lede: Pool days, naps and one popcorn heist. Tap any one to see it big.

love.lede: Two ways to reach her: real mail to the PO box, or a quick note right here.
love.mailText: Boomertanger has a PO box, and Skipper gets her mail there too. Fan Club members can send letters, cards and drawings to either of them, and Boomer reads the mail live on stream.
love.notesText: Tell her she's a good girl, share a story about your own dog, or just say hi. Every note is read before it goes up. Be one of the first to write to her.

askBoombot.q: Is Skipper a Pembroke or a Cardigan?
askBoombot.a: A Pembroke Welsh Corgi. The pointy ears give it away.

askBoombot.q: When is the Skipper Cam on?
askBoombot.a: Whenever Boomer's working in the office. It's for Fan Club members, and the sound is always off.
She pops in, usually for a treat break, and sleeps through a surprising number of jump scares.

askBoombot.q: Can I send her a note?
askBoombot.a: Yes. Write one in Skipper love at the bottom of the page. Every note is read before it goes up.
